_meta.indication: UNLOXCYT is a PD-L1 blocking antibody indicated for adults with metastatic cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma (mCSCC) or locally advanced CSCC (laCSCC) who are not candidates for curative surgery or curative radiation.

pivotal_trials.design: Open-label, multicenter, multiregional, single-arm, dose-escalation and cohort-expansion study of cosibelimab monotherapy.
pivotal_trials.population: Adults with unresectable locally advanced or metastatic CSCC not candidates for curative surgery or curative radiation.
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Confirmed objective response rate (ORR) by independent central review per RECIST v1.1, with duration of response (DOR).
pivotal_trials.n: Efficacy population of 109 patients (mCSCC N=78, laCSCC N=31).
pivotal_trials.result: mCSCC: confirmed ORR 47% (95% CI: 36, 59; n=37), 6 complete and 31 partial responses, median DOR not reached (range: 1.4+, 34.1+). laCSCC: ORR 48% (95% CI: 30, 67; n=15), 3 complete and 12 partial responses, median DOR 17.7 months (range: 3.7+, 17.7).

key_safety: Most common adverse reactions (≥10%): fatigue, musculoskeletal pain, rash, diarrhea, hypothyroidism, constipation, nausea, headache, pruritus, edema, localized infection, and urinary tract infection. Serious adverse reactions occurred in 31% of patients; most frequent (≥2%) were sepsis (2.8%), pneumonia (2.8%), and pyrexia (2.1%). Immune-mediated adverse reactions can occur in any organ system.
target_moa: Fully human IgG1 monoclonal antibody that binds PD-L1 and blocks its interaction with PD-1 and B7.1, releasing inhibition of the anti-tumor immune response; also induces antibody-dependent cell-mediated cytotoxicity (ADCC) in vitro.
companion_dx_detail: There is no device or companion diagnostic test for review in support of this BLA.

advisory_committee.vote: The Division did not refer this application to the Oncologic Drugs Advisory Committee (ODAC), as no significant review issues were identified.

summary.text: UNLOXCYT received traditional (regular) approval based on a durable ORR of sufficient magnitude from single-arm Study CK-301-101; no accelerated approval, breakthrough, orphan, or priority designations applied, and a prior Fast Track request was denied. The initial BLA received a Complete Response letter (December 15, 2023) over manufacturing facility deficiencies, and the resubmission was approved.
